Game Overview

Red Ball Bounce puts players into a monster experience centered on guide a determined red ball through a whimsical 2D platform adventure. Bounce over obstacles, collect stars, and dodge hostile squares as you journey across treacherous terrains. Master the physics of movement and timing to keep the ball rolling toward its ultimate goal in this charming escapade.
